stem: Which sentence from the selection suggests that Jonny needed to convince his community that his invention was worthwhile?

options.label: A
options.text: But for 12-year-old Jonny Cohen, the smell of exhaust from the buses parked in front of his junior high school got him thinking about school buses and how much gasoline they use.

options.label: B
options.text: He thought that improving its shape would reduce the amount of energy needed to move a bus.

options.label: C
options.text: With the help of his sister and friends, Jonny started his project, which he called GreenShields.

options.label: D
options.text: Getting votes wasn’t easy—he spoke with town councils, talked to customers at grocery stores, and used social media to ask for people’s support.
